required_outcomes: Recognises the latest email withdraws the roof leak report: the cause was a blocked gutter, now cleared, and no water is coming in.
Does not book a roofer or any contractor and keeps the oven request closed.
Replies to the tenant: thanks, and asks her to report straight away if water comes in again or if she notices staining or damp where it came in.
acceptable_alternatives: Recording the blocked gutter as a note or a low-priority record and telling the landlord as information, so gutter clearing can be planned.
Sending no reply beyond a short acknowledgement and returning the request to auto mode.
positive_behaviours: Suggests to the landlord that the gutters are checked or cleared periodically, since gutter maintenance usually falls to the landlord.
Avoids encouraging the tenant to climb ladders to clear gutters in future.
red_flags: Escalating to a human or putting the request on hold over a withdrawn report.
Reopening the oven request for the roof.
prohibited_actions: Booking a roofer or other contractor for a leak the tenant says has stopped.
critical_failures: Dispatching a contractor or seeking landlord approval for roof works after the tenant withdrew the report.
